from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,socket,os,select,time,importlib.util,hashlib
E=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W=Path('/Users/tt/Desktop/work/go/WuKongIM-v2/WuKongIM/.worktrees/rpc-native-gate')
def cmd(args,**kw):return subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,timeout=30,check=True,**kw)
results={}
# Local macOS functionality is deliberately excluded from native qualification.
sock=socket.socket();sock.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));addr='127.0.0.1:'+str(sock.getsockname()[1]);sock.close()
server_args=[str(E/'base-darwin'),'-mode=server','-addr='+addr,'-lifetime=15s']
server=subprocess.Popen(server_args,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=dict(os.environ,GOMAXPROCS='4'))
try:
 assert select.select([server.stdout],[],[],10)[0]
 assert server.stdout.readline().strip()==b'RPC_PROBE_READY'
 client_args=[str(E/'base-darwin'),'-addr='+addr,'-warmup=200ms','-duration=1s','-workers=2','-sample-cap=100000']
 p=cmd(client_args,env=dict(os.environ,GOMAXPROCS='4'));(E/'darwin-smoke.json').write_bytes(p.stdout);(E/'darwin-smoke.stderr').write_bytes(p.stderr)
 results['darwin']={'server_command':server_args,'client_command':client_args}
finally:
 server.terminate();out,err=server.communicate(timeout=10);(E/'darwin-server.log').write_bytes(out+err);assert server.returncode==0
# Linux amd64 binaries run only as a container/emulation functionality smoke here.
name='wk-native-gate-smoke'
args=['docker','run','-d','--name',name,'--pull=never','--platform','linux/amd64','-e','GOMAXPROCS=4','--memory','3g','-v',str(E)+':/bench:ro','--entrypoint','/bench/base-linux','debian:12','-mode=server','-addr=127.0.0.1:7001','-lifetime=30s']
created=False
try:
 cmd(args);created=True;deadline=time.monotonic()+15
 while b'RPC_PROBE_READY' not in cmd(['docker','logs',name]).stdout:
  assert time.monotonic()<deadline
  time.sleep(.1)
 c=['docker','run','--rm','--name',name+'-client','--pull=never','--platform','linux/amd64','--network','container:'+name,'-e','GOMAXPROCS=4','--memory','3g','-v',str(E)+':/bench:ro','--entrypoint','/bench/base-linux','debian:12','-warmup=200ms','-duration=1s','-workers=2','-sample-cap=100000']
 p=cmd(c);(E/'linux-smoke.json').write_bytes(p.stdout);(E/'linux-smoke.stderr').write_bytes(p.stderr);results['linux']={'server_command':args,'client_command':c}
finally:
 if created:
  cmd(['docker','stop','--time','5',name]);state=json.loads(cmd(['docker','inspect',name]).stdout)[0]['State'];assert state['ExitCode']==0 and not state['OOMKilled'] and not state['Running']
  results['linux']['cleanup_state']=state
  (E/'linux-server.log').write_bytes(cmd(['docker','logs',name]).stdout);cmd(['docker','rm',name])
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gate',W/'scripts/transport-perf/analyze.py');module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
for platform in ['darwin','linux']:
 r=json.loads((E/(platform+'-smoke.json')).read_text());assert r['Errors']==0 and not r['SampleCapHit'];n=r['Summary']['Calls'];assert n>0 and sum(r['WorkerCalls'])==n and sum(q['Calls'] for q in r['Seconds'])==n and r['ServerAfter']['EchoCalls']-r['ServerBefore']['EchoCalls']==n
 binary=E/('base-'+platform)
 assert r['Client']['BinarySHA256']==hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['ServerBefore']['Host']['BinarySHA256']
 try:module.validate(r)
 except ValueError as e:rejection=str(e)
 else:raise AssertionError('unsupported smoke accepted for qualification')
 results[platform].update(calls=n,native_qualification_rejection=rejection)
assert 'wk-native-gate-smoke' not in cmd(['docker','ps','-a','--format','{{.Names}}']).stdout.decode()
(E/'smoke-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:{'calls':v['calls'],'qualification_rejection':v['native_qualification_rejection']} for k,v in results.items()},indent=2))
